title: Add firearms, magazine/chamber state, unload/reload actions, gunshot acoustics, and cross-way shooting

sections.what: Extend the bow-only ranged combat foundation (task-518) with firearm chamber/magazine state, explicit unload and reload actions, gunshot sound propagation via engine/sound.py, and cross-way shooting across open/see-through sightlines.
sections.why: task-518 implemented same-area bow shooting in engine/combat.py (lines 693-725) using loose 'ammo' nodes in inventory and explicitly deferred range/magazine semantics. For modern firearm encounters, a gun needs loaded chamber/magazine capacity, explicit unload (emptying a confiscated pistol) and reload actions, audible gunshots through engine/sound.py, and firing along open sightlines (engine/beyond_visibility.py).
sections.how:
1. Extend engine/combat.py ranged model (preserving task-518 bow path untouched): distinguish chambered/magazine-fed firearms from draw-and-loose bows via loaded_ammo/capacity (or attached magazine child node), enforcing click/empty failure when loaded_ammo == 0.
2. Register reload and unload verbs in engine/action_verbs.py and routes/action_handlers.py so characters can clear chamber/eject magazines (e.g. removing bullets from a disarmed pistol) or chamber fresh ammo/magazines.
3. Connect firearm discharge in engine/combat.py to engine/sound.py (emitting a transient gunshot sound event with directional heard_from / sound_pattern across propagate_sound, unless suppressed).
4. Support ranged targeting along open/see_through ways returned by engine/beyond_visibility.py (sightline_run) with range/cover modifiers alongside same-area targets.
sections.verify: 1. Run existing tests/test_ranged_combat.py plus new pytest suite testing firearm unload/reload, empty click failure, gunshot sound_source propagation to adjacent rooms, and cross-way sightline targeting.

acceptance.text: Firearm items track loaded round capacity / detachable magazine state separate from abstract carried 'ammo', supporting explicit unload <weapon> and reload <weapon> character actions.
Firing a firearm (or explosive) emits a transient high-penetration gunshot sound wave through engine/sound.py (propagate_sound) alerting nearby areas and bystanders rather than firing silently.

Ranged attacks can resolve along clear open or see-through sightlines from engine/beyond_visibility.py (sightline_run) in addition to same-area targets while preserving bow/quiver behavior from task-518.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal weapon action brackets (`reload`, `unload`), Inspector item properties, and Event Stream acoustic gunshot alerts.

Current availability: task-518 implemented same-area bow firing in engine/combat.py (_is_ranged_weapon, _carried_ammo_node, _spend_ammo) with no unload/reload verbs, no gunshot sound propagation, and no cross-way sightline targeting.

Manual verification steps:
1. Equip a pistol/rifle with loaded ammo (and spare ammo/magazine) and run `unload <weapon>`, attempt attack while empty, then `reload <weapon>` and fire near an adjacent connected room.
   - expected: Empty chamber fails cleanly, reload loads carried ammo/mag into the weapon, unload ejects remaining round(s)/mag back to carried/item state, and firing broadcasts a loud gunshot sound wave to connected areas.
